Item 1. Business

Example Corp designs and sells widget-optimization software delivered as a subscription platform. Our platform ingests telemetry from customer widget fleets and applies proprietary scheduling models to reduce widget downtime. We generate substantially all of our revenue from subscription contracts with terms of one to three years. During fiscal 2025 our largest customer accounted for approximately 24% of total revenue.

We operate a single cloud region and rely on one hyperscale infrastructure provider for substantially all of our compute capacity.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

The loss of our largest customer, which represented approximately 24% of revenue, would materially harm our results of operations. We are currently a defendant in a patent infringement lawsuit filed by WidgetPatents LLC seeking damages and an injunction against the sale of our core product. An adverse outcome could require us to redesign our platform or cease selling it.

We have a history of losses and may require additional financing on terms that could be dilutive to existing stockholders.

Item 2. Properties

We lease our headquarters facility.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue growth decelerated during the second half of the year, which we attribute primarily to elongated sales cycles in our enterprise segment. We previously expected full-year revenue growth of approximately 35% and now expect growth of approximately 25%. We believe our cash and cash equivalents will be sufficient to fund operations for at least the next twelve months.
